items.source: Set the Marshaller to be used by this message converter.
items.translation: 设置Marshaller供此消息转换器使用。

items.source: Set the Unmarshaller to be used by this message converter.
items.translation: 设置此消息转换器使用的Unmarshaller。

items.source: This converter requires a Marshaller and Unmarshaller before it can be used. These can be injected by the constructor or bean properties.
items.translation: 此转换器在使用之前需要一个 `Marshaller` 和一个 `Unmarshaller`。它们可以通过构造函数或Bean 属性注入。

items.source: By default, this converter supports text/xml and application/xml. This can be overridden by setting the supportedMediaTypes property.
items.translation: 默认情况下，此转换器支持 `text/xml` 和 `application/xml`。可以通过设置 supportedMediaTypes 属性来覆盖此行为。

items.source: If the given Marshaller also implements the Unmarshaller interface, it is used for both marshalling and unmarshalling. Otherwise, an exception is thrown.
items.translation: 如果给定的Marshaller也实现了Unmarshaller接口，则它同时用于序列化和反序列化。否则，将抛出异常。

items.source: Note that all Marshaller implementations in Spring also implement the Unmarshaller interface, so that you can safely use this constructor.
items.translation: 注意，Spring 中的所有 `Marshaller` 实现也都实现了 `Unmarshaller` 接口，因此您可以安全地使用此构造函数。

items.source: Construct a new MarshallingHttpMessageConverter with no Marshaller or Unmarshaller set. The Marshaller and Unmarshaller must be set after construction by invoking setMarshaller(Marshaller) and setUnmarshaller(Unmarshaller).
items.translation: 构建一个新的不带已设置Marshaller或Unmarshaller的MarshallingHttpMessageConverter。必须在构建后通过调用setMarshaller(Marshaller)和setUnmarshaller(Unmarshaller)来设置 Marshaller 和 Unmarshaller。

items.source: Construct a new MarshallingHttpMessageConverter with no Marshaller or Unmarshaller set.
items.translation: 构建一个新的 MarshallingHttpMessageConverter，不设置任何 Marshaller 或 Unmarshaller。

items.source: Construct a new MarshallingMessageConverter with the given Marshaller set.
items.translation: 使用给定的Marshaller集构造一个新的MarshallingMessageConverter。

items.source: Construct a new MarshallingMessageConverter with the given Marshaller and Unmarshaller.
items.translation: 使用给定的 Marshaller 和 Unmarshaller 构建一个新的 MarshallingMessageConverter。

items.source: This implementation checks if the given class is supported, and if the supported media types include the given media type.
items.translation: 此实现检查给定类是否受支持，并且如果支持的媒体类型包含给定的媒体类型。

items.source: This implementation checks if the given class is supported, and if the supported media types include the given media type.
items.translation: 此实现检查给定类是否受支持，以及受支持的媒体类型是否包含给定的媒体类型。
